baseline_evidence: PR #324 / run 35880062788 qualified the time-aware Gummel architecture.
Gen13 basis run 35978463311 directly identified a full-rank 20x20 electron-map Jacobian around the accepted step-1 state.
Gen13 A1/A2 small-gamma runs showed diagonal reaction screening slows the dominant Gummel mode rather than accelerating it.

objective.architecture_invariant: retain the Gummel electron/energy <-> Poisson fixed-point architecture
objective.metric: average fixed-point loops per electron step
objective.success_condition: materially lower FP work with stable four-step completion and qualified trajectory/profile parity; O(10) remains the promotion target

frozen_invariants: plasma equations and BC ownership at the converged fixed point
thermal charged-heavy wall plus sheath-suppressed electron wall model

hypotheses.statement: The useful electron-potential Jacobian structure is primarily conservative/nonlocal rather than a local reaction term; a row-sum-preserving Laplacian-like correction can improve Gummel contraction without creating the artificial absolute-potential stiffness seen in Gen13 A1/A2.
hypotheses.mechanism: Approximate the measured positive-diagonal/negative-off-diagonal electron response with -div(kappa_e grad(phi-phi_anchor)). The correction has graph-Laplacian structure, annihilates constant potential shifts, and vanishes at the converged Gummel fixed point.
hypotheses.falsifier: Reject the tested Laplacian approximation if both calibrated variants fail to reduce FP work versus the same-lane control, become unstable, or violate same-time solution parity.
prior_evidence: Gen13 basis Jacobian is full rank and has off-diagonal Frobenius fraction about 0.310.
All measured off-diagonal entries are negative while diagonal entries are positive.
Row sums are near zero relative to the diagonal, showing strong cancellation for smooth/constant potential modes.
Direct nearest-neighbor projection of the A1 susceptibility gives c_nn=0.11722721584956464; the best row-sum-preserving local-Laplacian projection of the full matrix gives c_full=0.28655741183724337.

discriminating_observables: residual stability over four electron steps
final electron density, mean energy, potential and charge profile parity
controls: same-lane unmodified qualified time-aware Picard-2x control
one heavy cycle / four electron steps / T=400 tau_epsilon(initial)
identical physics, timestep, wall model, convergence tolerances and stopping criteria
correction acts on phi-phi_anchor and only on internal faces

variants.change: state-aware A1 Laplacian coefficient c=0.11722721584956464, fitted to the directly measured nearest-neighbor off-diagonal coupling
state-aware A1 Laplacian coefficient c=0.28655741183724337, least-squares projection of the full Gen13 basis Jacobian onto a row-sum-preserving local Laplacian
